SELECT p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME AS scientific_name, p.COMMON_NAME AS common_name, p.SAMPLE_IMAGE_URL AS sample_image_url, COUNT(mp.PLANT_SCIENTIFIC_NAME) AS plant_count,
t.TAG_ID AS tag_id, t.TAG_NAME AS tag_name, t.PARENT_TAG_ID AS parent_tag_id, t.DESCRIPTION AS tag_description, t.CREATED_AT AS tag_created_at, t.UPDATED_AT AS tag_updated_at
FROM plant_info p INNER JOIN my_plant mp ON p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME = mp.PLANT_SCIENTIFIC_NAME
LEFT JOIN plant_tag_with ptw ON p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME = ptw.PLANT_SCIENTIFIC_NAME
LEFT JOIN plant_tag t ON ptw.TAG_ID = t.TAG_ID
GROUP BY p.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, p.COMMON_NAME, p.SAMPLE_IMAGE_URL, t.TAG_ID, t.TAG_NAME, t.PARENT_TAG_ID, t.DESCRIPTION, t.CREATED_AT, t.UPDATED_AT
ORDER BY plant_count DESC
